---
title: "Unified Report Model"
---

SCGSim plans a Plotly-default report envelope that gives different solvers one
consistent reading experience without pretending their physical quantities are
identical.

## Common envelope

Every future report may organize:

1. physical quantities;
2. convergence and solver diagnostics;
3. simulation cost and resource benchmarks;
4. provenance and artifact identities.

## Honesty rule

Solver-specific quantities remain solver-specific. Electrostatic matrices,
eigenfrequencies, driven network responses, field-energy participation, Q3D
matrices, and Q2D per-unit-length results must retain their own units,
extraction authority, and failure meaning.

Plotly is the planned default presentation layer, not a Phase-1 implemented API.
